hear.label: Hearing
hear.about: Johnston's organ auditory neurons (the fly's ear) while it reads your message

think.label: Deliberating
think.about: PFN columnar neurons feeding the central complex, the fly's action-selection hub, while the LLM reasons

memory.label: Remembering
memory.about: a sparse set of Kenyon cells (about 5%) in the mushroom body; each memory gets its own set, like an odour

stimuli.label: Sugar
stimuli.about: Sugar-sensing taste neurons on the labellum (Gr64f / Gr5a)

stimuli.label: Water
stimuli.about: Water-sensing taste neurons on the labellum (ppk28)

stimuli.label: Bitter
stimuli.about: Bitter-sensing taste neurons on the labellum (Gr33a)

stimuli.label: Antenna touch
stimuli.about: Johnston's organ touch neurons in the antenna (JO-C, D, E, F)

stimuli.label: Light on
stimuli.about: ON-pathway cells Mi1 and Tm3 (photoreceptors inhibit, so light enters here)

stimuli.label: Fruity odour
stimuli.about: Or42b olfactory neurons (glomerulus DM1), vinegar and fruit esters

stimuli.label: Geosmin
stimuli.about: Or56a neurons (DA2), smell of harmful mould

stimuli.label: Carbon dioxide
stimuli.about: Gr21a/Gr63a neurons (V glomerulus), a stress odour

stimuli.label: Leg touch
stimuli.about: Bristle touch neurons on the front legs
